main.description: Marks a post as token gated. The post itself is public and acts as a teaser; the gated part lives on the gate service and is only served to viewers whose linked wallets meet the conditions.

subject.description: The gated post. Must be in the same repo as this record.

match.description: Whether the viewer must meet all conditions or any one of them. Defaults to 'all'.

service.description: DID of the gate service holding the content (service id #krao_gate).
